verdict.rationale: Omarchy's docs say graphics drivers and configuration, including NVIDIA on supported hardware, are set up during installation. That covers the GPU-driver half of the story, but only in a gaming context. Nothing in the evidence addresses building custom kernel modules or setting up compute or accelerated workloads such as CUDA or ROCm. Missing for 10: documented custom kernel module/DKMS build workflow, GPU compute stack setup for accelerated workloads, detail on supported NVIDIA hardware, independent hands-on corroboration of driver setup.
